# Golden test data

- `golden_lunar2solar.txt` — 59,810 lunar→solar conversions (years 1900–2199,
  both UTC+7 and UTC+9) generated by the production JavaScript implementation
  inside [TEdu](https://github.com/doxuta/tedu). Format:
  `tz lunarYear lunarMonth lunarDay leap solarY solarM solarD`.
- `golden_lowlevel.txt` — sampled new-moon Julian days (`NM k tz jd`) and
  solar-longitude sectors (`SL jdn tz sector`) from the same implementation.
- `fuzz/` — regression corpus: inputs that once broke the port (kept forever).

The Go engine must reproduce the golden values bit-for-bit, except where it
deliberately validates harder than the reference (see DESIGN.md).
